    <li><a href="https://thebogeyclub.com/private-events/">Private events</a></li>

    <li><a href="https://thebogeyclub.com/the-bogey-club-classic-2026/">Bogey Club Classic</a></li>
  </ul></div>

<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@graph": [
    {
      "@type": "Person",
      "@id": "https://thebogeyclub.com/meet-our-pro/#andrew",
      "name": "Andrew McDonald",
      "jobTitle": "Associate Professional, PGA of Canada",
      "image": "https://thebogeyclub.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/1000004121-scaled.jpg",
      "email": "mailto:amcdonald@magnagolf.com",
      "worksFor": {
        "@id": "https://thebogeyclub.com/#business"
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Service",
      "name": "Private golf lessons",
      "serviceType": "Golf instruction",
      "url": "https://thebogeyclub.com/meet-our-pro/",
      "areaServed": "Newmarket, Ontario",
      "provider": {
        "@id": "https://thebogeyclub.com/meet-our-pro/#andrew"
      },
      "description": "One-on-one golf lessons on Golfzon simulators with Andrew McDonald, PGA of Canada, covering technique, strategy and the mental game."
    }
  ]
}
</script>
<script>
/* The Bogey Club — site script (production). Vanilla, no dependencies,
   no tracking (CTAs carry data-tt-cta for the site's existing GTM/GA).
   Install once, site-wide: WPCode footer snippet (see 02-script.html). */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  document.documentElement.classList.add("tt-js"); /* lets the CSS show script-only parts */
  function ready(fn) { if (document.readyState !== "loading") fn(); else document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn); }

  /* Contact form destination. Leave empty to open the visitor's email app;
     set to a Formspree form URL (https://formspree.io/f/xxxxxxx) to send in-page. */
  var FORM_ENDPOINT = "";
  var CLUB_EMAIL = "golf@thebogeyclub.com";

  ready(function () {
    var html = document.documentElement;
    var reduce = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    /* each feature runs on its own, so one failure never takes the others down */
    var fail = function (err) { if (window.console) console.error("[Bogey Club]", err); };

    try {
    /* Karaoke booking: open the karaoke-filtered calendar on the current month
       (same behaviour as the /karaoke/ page). */
    var now = new Date(), month = now.getFullYear() + "-" + String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-tt-link="karaoke-booking"]').forEach(function (a) {
      a.href = "https://thebogeyclub.golfbooking.ca/calendar.php?date=" + month + "&bayfilter=4&templateId=50&lang=en";
    });
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-tt-year]").forEach(function (el) { el.textContent = now.getFullYear(); });

    } catch (err) { fail(err); }
    try {
    /* A missing photo shows the pine frame, never a broken-image icon. */
    document.querySelectorAll(".tt img").forEach(function (img) {
      function miss() { img.classList.add("tt-missing"); }
      if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth === 0 && img.currentSrc) miss();
      else img.addEventListener("error", miss, { once: true });
    });

    } catch (err) { fail(err); }
    try {
    /* Hero video: reveal it only once frames are playing; otherwise keep the still. */
    var hero = document.querySelector(".tt .hero"), vid = hero && hero.querySelector(".hero-video");
    if (vid) {
      var drop = function () { vid.remove(); };
      if (reduce || window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-data: reduce)").matches) drop();
      else {
        vid.addEventListener("playing", function () { hero.classList.add("is-playing"); }, { once: true });
        var srcs = vid.querySelectorAll("source");
        if (srcs.length) srcs[srcs.length - 1].addEventListener("error", drop);
        vid.addEventListener("error", drop);
        var p = vid.play && vid.play();
        if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function () { /* autoplay blocked: the still stays */ });
      }
    }

    } catch (err) { fail(err); }
    try {
    /* Two bars: roll the golf ball (or use arrow keys) to compare; on desktop it follows the pointer. */
    var duo = document.getElementById("tt-duo");
    if (duo) {
      var range = duo.querySelector(".duo-range");
      var setX = function (v) {
        v = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v));
        duo.style.setProperty("--x", v + "%"); range.value = Math.round(v);
        duo.style.setProperty("--rot", (v * 7.2).toFixed(1) + "deg"); /* the ball rolls as it moves */
        duo.dataset.side = v > 60 ? "a" : v < 40 ? "b" : "";
      };
      var fromEvent = function (e) { var r = duo.getBoundingClientRect(); return (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width * 100; };
      var used = function () { duo.classList.add("used"); };
      range.addEventListener("input", function () { setX(Number(range.value)); used(); });
      duo.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (e) { duo.classList.add("drag"); setX(fromEvent(e)); used(); });
      duo.addEventListener("pointermove", function (e) {
        if (duo.classList.contains("drag") || e.pointerType === "mouse") { setX(fromEvent(e)); if (e.pointerType === "mouse") used(); }
      });
      ["pointerup", "pointercancel", "pointerleave"].forEach(function (t) { duo.addEventListener(t, function () { duo.classList.remove("drag"); }); });
      /* gentle intro: the handle sweeps once when the section first appears */
      if ("IntersectionObserver" in window && !reduce) {
        var dio = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
          if (!es[0].isIntersecting || duo.classList.contains("used")) return;
          dio.disconnect();
          var t0 = performance.now();
          (function step(t) {
            if (duo.classList.contains("used")) return;
            var k = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / 1800);
            setX(50 + Math.sin(k * Math.PI * 2) * 22 * (1 - k));
            if (k < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
          })(t0);
        }, { threshold: .5 });
        dio.observe(duo);
      }
      /* count-up for the numbers */
      var nums = document.querySelectorAll(".bars-stats [data-count]");
      if (nums.length && "IntersectionObserver" in window && !reduce) {
        nums.forEach(function (el) { el.textContent = "0"; });
        var nio = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
          if (!es[0].isIntersecting) return; nio.disconnect();
          nums.forEach(function (el) {
            var end = Number(el.dataset.count), t0 = performance.now();
            (function tick(t) { var k = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / 900); el.textContent = Math.round(end * (1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3))); if (k < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick); })(t0);
          });
        }, { threshold: .6 });
        nio.observe(nums[0].parentElement.parentElement);
      }
    }

    } catch (err) { fail(err); }
    try {
    /* Club life: hovering/focusing a row wipes its photo into the panel (desktop);
       on phones each row's thumbnail wipes in as it scrolls into view. */
    var lifeRows = document.querySelectorAll("#tt-rows .row"), figs = document.querySelectorAll("#tt-life-media figure");
    if (lifeRows.length && figs.length) {
      var cur = 0, num = document.getElementById("tt-life-n");
      var setRow = function (i) {
        if (i === cur) return;
        figs.forEach(function (f, k) { f.classList.toggle("was", k === cur); f.classList.remove("on"); });
        figs[i].classList.add("on");
        lifeRows.forEach(function (r, k) { r.classList.toggle("on", k === i); });
        if (num) num.textContent = String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0");
        cur = i;
      };
      var hover = window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (min-width: 861px)");
      lifeRows.forEach(function (r, i) {
        r.addEventListener("mouseenter", function () { if (hover.matches) setRow(i); });
        r.addEventListener("focus", function () { setRow(i); });
      });
      var rowsBox = document.getElementById("tt-rows");
      if ("IntersectionObserver" in window && !reduce) {
        rowsBox.classList.add("anim");
        var rio = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
          es.forEach(function (e) { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add("in"); rio.unobserve(e.target); } });
        }, { threshold: .35 });
        lifeRows.forEach(function (r) { rio.observe(r); });
      }
    }

    } catch (err) { fail(err); }
    try {
    /* Sponsors: cards rise in, then a spotlight cycles through each sponsor.
       Hovering or focusing a card takes the spotlight; leaving resumes the cycle. */
    var signs = document.getElementById("tt-signs");
    if (signs) {
      var items = signs.querySelectorAll("li"), cards = signs.querySelectorAll(".bay"), lit = -1, timer = null;
      var light = function (i) { lit = i; cards.forEach(function (c, k) { c.classList.toggle("lit", k === i); }); };
      var start = function () { if (reduce || timer) return; timer = setInterval(function () { light((lit + 1) % cards.length); }, 3200); };
      var stop = function () { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; };
      cards.forEach(function (c, i) {
        c.addEventListener("mouseenter", function () { stop(); light(i); });
        c.addEventListener("focus", function () { stop(); light(i); });
      });
      signs.addEventListener("mouseleave", start);
      signs.addEventListener("focusout", function (e) { if (!signs.contains(e.relatedTarget)) start(); });
      if ("IntersectionObserver" in window && !reduce) {
        signs.classList.add("anim");
        var sio = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
          es.forEach(function (e) {
            if (e.isIntersecting) { items.forEach(function (li) { li.classList.add("in"); }); if (lit < 0) setTimeout(function () { light(0); start(); }, 900); }
            else stop();
            if (e.isIntersecting && lit >= 0) start();
          });
        }, { threshold: .3 });
        sio.observe(signs);
      }
    }

    } catch (err) { fail(err); }
    try {
    /* WPForms: if the contact form (WPForms form 3352) is anywhere on the
       page, move it into the contact card and use it instead of the built-in form. */
    var WPFORMS_ID = "3352"; /* the "Website contact" form. Never write its shortcode in this file: WordPress would run it inside the script. */
    var wpf = document.getElementById("wpforms-" + WPFORMS_ID) || document.querySelector(".tt-wpforms .wpforms-container, .wpforms-container.tt-wpforms");
    var slot = document.getElementById("tt-cslot");
    if (wpf && slot && !slot.contains(wpf)) {
      var host = wpf.closest(".elementor-element:not(.elementor-widget-html)");
      slot.appendChild(wpf);
      document.getElementById("tt-ccard").classList.add("has-wpf");
      if (host && !host.contains(wpf)) host.style.display = "none";
    }

    } catch (err) { fail(err); }
    try {
    /* Links like "Talk to us about sponsorship" jump to the form and pick its topic */
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-tt-topic]").forEach(function (a) {
      a.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var t = a.getAttribute("data-tt-topic"), sel = document.querySelector('#tt-cform [name="tt_topic"]');
        if (sel) sel.value = t;
        var first = document.querySelector("#tt-ccard.has-wpf input:not([type=hidden]), .tt-wpforms input:not([type=hidden]), #tt-cform [name=tt_name]");
        if (first) setTimeout(function () { first.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, 600);
      });
    });
    } catch (err) { fail(err); }
    try {
    /* Contact form */
    var cform = document.getElementById("tt-cform");
    if (cform) {
      var status = cform.querySelector(".cstatus"), sendBtn = cform.querySelector("button[type=submit]");
      var say = function (msg, err) { status.textContent = msg; status.classList.toggle("err", !!err); };
      cform.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var ok = true;
        cform.querySelectorAll("[required]").forEach(function (f) {
          var bad = !f.value.trim() || (f.type === "email" && !/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(f.value));
          f.closest(".cfield").classList.toggle("bad", bad); if (bad && ok) { f.focus(); ok = false; }
        });
        if (!ok) { say("Please fill in your name, a valid email and a message.", true); return; }
        if (cform.elements._gotcha.value) return;
        var d = {}; ["name", "email", "phone", "topic", "message"].forEach(function (k) { d[k] = cform.elements["tt_" + k].value.trim(); });
        if (FORM_ENDPOINT) {
          sendBtn.disabled = true; say("Sending…");
          fetch(FORM_ENDPOINT, { method: "POST", headers: { "Accept": "application/json", "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ _subject: "Website message: " + d.topic }, d)) })
            .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw 0; cform.reset(); say("Thanks, " + d.name.split(" ")[0] + "! Your message is in. We'll be in touch soon."); })
            .catch(function () { say("Sorry, that didn't send. Please email " + CLUB_EMAIL + " or call (905) 235-4653.", true); })
            .then(function () { sendBtn.disabled = false; });
        } else {
          var body = d.message + "\n\n— " + d.name + "\n" + d.email + (d.phone ? "\n" + d.phone : "");
          window.location.href = "mailto:" + CLUB_EMAIL + "?subject=" + encodeURIComponent("Website message: " + d.topic) + "&body=" + encodeURIComponent(body);
          say("Your email app should open with your message ready to send.");
        }
      });
      cform.addEventListener("input", function (e) { var f = e.target.closest(".cfield"); if (f) f.classList.remove("bad"); });
    }

    } catch (err) { fail(err); }
    try {
    /* Lessons page: the simulator "screen". Tabs switch modes, the numbers count up,
       and it cycles on its own while in view (paused on hover, focus or reduced motion). */
    var sim = document.getElementById("tt-sim");
    if (sim) {
      var tabs = sim.querySelectorAll(".ls-tab"), panels = sim.querySelectorAll(".ls-panel");
      var CYCLE = 6000, si = 0, stimer = null, inView = false, held = false;
      var count = function (panel) {
        panel.querySelectorAll("[data-to]").forEach(function (el) {
          var end = Number(el.dataset.to), dec = Number(el.dataset.dec || 0), unit = el.dataset.unit || "";
          if (reduce) { el.textContent = end.toFixed(dec) + unit; return; }
          var t0 = performance.now();
          (function tick(t) { var k = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / 900), v = end * (1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3));
            el.textContent = v.toFixed(dec) + unit; if (k < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick); })(t0);
        });
      };
      var show = function (i, focus) {
        si = (i + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
        tabs.forEach(function (t, k) { var on = k === si; t.classList.toggle("on", on); t.setAttribute("aria-selected", on); t.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1; });
        panels.forEach(function (p, k) { var on = k === si; p.classList.toggle("on", on); p.hidden = !on; });
        if (focus) tabs[si].focus();
        count(panels[si]);
        restart();
      };
      var restart = function () {
        clearTimeout(stimer); sim.classList.remove("cycling");
        if (reduce || held || !inView) return;
        void sim.offsetWidth; sim.classList.add("cycling"); sim.style.setProperty("--cycle", CYCLE + "ms");
        stimer = setTimeout(function () { show(si + 1); }, CYCLE);
      };
      tabs.forEach(function (t, k) {
        t.addEventListener("click", function () { held = true; show(k); });
        t.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
          var d = e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowUp" ? -1 : 0;
          if (d) { e.preventDefault(); held = true; show(si + d, true); }
        });
      });
      sim.addEventListener("mouseenter", function () { held = true; restart(); });
      sim.addEventListener("mouseleave", function () { held = false; restart(); });
      if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
        new IntersectionObserver(function (es) { inView = es[0].isIntersecting; if (inView) count(panels[si]); restart(); }, { threshold: .35 }).observe(sim);
      }
    }
    } catch (err) { fail(err); }
    try {
    /* Mobile menu */
    var btn = document.querySelector(".tt .menu"), sheet = document.getElementById("tt-mnav");
    if (btn && sheet) {
      var setOpen = function (open) {
        btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
        btn.textContent = open ? "Close" : "Menu";
        sheet.classList.toggle("open", open);
        html.classList.toggle("tt-lock", open);
        if (open) { var first = sheet.querySelector("a"); if (first) first.focus(); }
      };
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () { setOpen(btn.getAttribute("aria-expanded") !== "true"); });
      sheet.addEventListener("click", function (e) { if (e.target.closest("a")) setOpen(false); });
      document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Escape" && sheet.classList.contains("open")) { setOpen(false); btn.focus(); } });
      window.matchMedia("(min-width: 861px)").addEventListener("change", function (mq) { if (mq.matches) setOpen(false); });
    }

    } catch (err) { fail(err); }
    try {
    /* From the tee to the tap: on a wide screen with a mouse, vertical scroll drives a
       horizontal dolly (.dolly). Everywhere else (phones, tablets, touch screens,
       reduced motion) the CSS stacks the four stops so every one is seen. */
    var walk = document.getElementById("walk"), track = document.getElementById("tt-track");
    if (walk && track) {
      var desk = window.matchMedia("(min-width: 1025px) and (min-height: 600px) and (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)");
      var prog = document.getElementById("tt-prog"), stops = document.querySelectorAll("#tt-stops li");
      var cards = track.querySelectorAll(".stop");
      var dolly = function () { return desk.matches && !reduce; };
      var mark = function (k) {
        prog.style.width = (k * 100) + "%";
        var idx = Math.min(stops.length - 1, Math.round(k * (stops.length - 1)));
        stops.forEach(function (s, i) { s.classList.toggle("on", i === idx); });
      };
      var onScroll = function () {
        if (!dolly()) return;
        var travel = track.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth, span = walk.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
        if (travel <= 0 || span <= 0) return;
        var k = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, -walk.getBoundingClientRect().top / span));
        track.style.transform = "translate3d(" + (-k * travel) + "px,0,0)";
        mark(k);
      };
      var size = function () {
        var on = dolly();
        walk.classList.toggle("dolly", on);
        if (!on) { walk.style.height = ""; track.style.transform = ""; return; }
        walk.style.height = (window.innerHeight + Math.max(0, track.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth)) + "px";
        onScroll();
      };
      var go = function (i) {
        if (!dolly()) { cards[i].scrollIntoView({ behavior: reduce ? "auto" : "smooth", block: "start" }); return; }
        var span = walk.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
        window.scrollTo({ top: window.scrollY + walk.getBoundingClientRect().top + span * i / Math.max(1, cards.length - 1), behavior: "smooth" });
      };
      document.querySelectorAll("#tt-stops [data-go]").forEach(function (b) {
        b.addEventListener("click", function () { go(+b.getAttribute("data-go")); });
      });
      window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener("resize", size);
      window.addEventListener("load", size);
      if (desk.addEventListener) desk.addEventListener("change", size);
      size();
    }

    } catch (err) { fail(err); }
  });
})();
</script>
</div>
